changelog: New voice command "select last character" — say "select last character" alone while dictating (or "শেষ অক্ষর সিলেক্ট করো") and the last letter before the cursor gets selected, so you can dictate the correct letter over it or copy just that letter. Before, only the whole last word could be selected. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
